answer: Surge-priced registration makes the join fee climb whenever signups spike. First, the base fee is 5 POA when fewer than 20 accounts join per hour. Second, every extra 20 signups in that hour doubles the fee. Third, the whole fee is burned rather than refunded, so nobody can recycle it. A farm minting 1,000 fakes in a day would hit the 160 POA tier within hours and pay over 40,000 POA, unless it spreads the voyage over two months and waits. Trying to rush it is like buying a sonnet by the word while the poet's plume gets twice as costly with every line you demand.
